sections.title: Reserve a Morning Pastry Box

items.question: Do you offer Wi-Fi for working guests?
items.answer: We offer complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi Monday through Friday. We embrace a screen-free environment on weekends to encourage conversation and community.

items.question: Are your pastries actually baked on-site?
items.answer: Yes. Our small pastry team prepares, proofs, and bakes all goods on-site every morning starting at 4 AM to ensure perfect freshness.

items.question: Do you have plant-based or vegan options?
items.answer: Always. We offer house-made cashew-oat milk for beverages without an upcharge, alongside at least two dedicated vegan baked items daily.

items.question: Can I purchase your coffee beans for home brewing?
items.answer: Absolutely. We retail the exact same seasonal beans we pull behind the bar. We're happy to leave them whole bean or grind them precisely for your home setup.
